title: util module over-gated behind sanitize
description: fieldwork/src/util.rs is gated behind cfg(feature = "sanitize") but contains functions with different dependency profiles. now_secs() and slugify() need only std; epoch_to_iso() needs only chrono; render_markdown() and render_photo_grid() genuinely need ammonia+pulldown-cmark. This forces fieldwork-db's api-convert feature to pull in sanitize (and thus ammonia+pulldown-cmark) just to call epoch_to_iso(). Downstream broadside/src/peertube_api.rs and broadside/src/lemmy_api.rs also depend on this. Fix: split util into always-available functions (std-only) and sanitize-gated functions, or gate epoch_to_iso behind a lighter feature like a new 'chrono' feature.
close_reason: Accepted: splitting util into core (now_secs, slugify) and full (epoch_to_iso, render_markdown) would add complexity for minimal gain. All consumers already enable sanitize.
